title: Multi-Agent Sovereignty — Codex Plugin + Obsidian Skills + Octopus Consensus + Ollama-qwen + H-drive Roadmap Home
brief: Wire openai/codex-plugin-cc (Apache-2.0) + kepano/obsidian-skills (MIT) + nyldn/claude-octopus consensus pattern (MIT) into PRISM as a unified multi-agent dev/review surface. Codex plans + Claude builds + ollama-qwen offloads cheap classification + 5-provider 75% consensus gate fires on shop_floor-tier edits. Foundation phase (P0) enforces that every roadmap/milestone/position file lives on H: so every chat and every machine follows the same canonical plan. Knowledge sources: YouTube videos Fu5KIG2Jm1g (Run Together) + RChO5deJ_fE (Plan Together), repo READMEs, existing INTEL-OLLAMA-OBSIDIAN-MS0 substrate.

YouTube RChO5deJ_fE — Make Claude + Codex Plan Together

phases.title: Octopus Consensus Gate — 75% N-of-5 quorum on shop-floor edits, plus AGENT_CONFLICT_ARBITRATION fix
phases.rationale: Shop-floor tier requires Ω≥0.95 / S(x)≥0.98 — five-sigma. Single-provider review can't hit five-sigma on its own. Lifting the claude-octopus 75% consensus pattern (MIT) over 5 independent providers (Claude + Codex + qwen2.5-coder + qwen2.5 + ollama-mistral) provides independent error sampling. P4 also fixes the AGENT_CONFLICT_ARBITRATION substrate that the prior audit identified as missing — the consensus gate's dissent log lives there.

units.title: Build PRISMConsensusGateEngine — N-provider parallel query with quorum threshold
exit_conditions: Engine runs ≤5 providers in parallel with 45s timeout each
Reports per-provider verdict + dissent rationale + quorum decision (PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL)
Partial quorum (≥3-of-5 valid) → CONDITIONAL with explicit downgrade flag
Cache by content hash so re-run with no code change returns cached decision (prevents quorum gaming)
≥1 cloud provider (Claude OR Codex) MUST be in the active quorum — gate refuses to vote with only ollama providers; enforced in code AND asserted by Test 9

Codex provider chunks any input >18K tokens into ≤16K-token windows before review; per-chunk verdicts merged via majority within the provider's vote — asserted by Test 10 with synthetic 25K-token diff

Test cases (10 total): 5 unanimous-correct, 1 split 3v2, 1 unanimous-wrong-detected-by-dissent, 1 timeout-fallback, 1 cloud-provider-mandatory (4-ollama-only call refused), 1 oversized-input chunked-review correctness

deliverables.description: 10 quorum scenarios (5 unanimous-correct, split, dissent-detect, timeout, cloud-mandatory, chunked-review)

phases.title: Multi-Chat Coordination Hardening — edit-time lane gate, auto-fork on conflict, cross-chat directive detection, arbitration audit log
phases.rationale: Existing rails (commit-ownership-guard, worktree-commit-route, chat-bus-inject) fire at COMMIT time or are advisory only. By then a chat has already produced an hour of work in a peer's tree, and the printed `git worktree add` instruction is sometimes parsed wrong or skipped under context pressure. This phase closes the gap with edit-time enforcement, automated fork execution, prompt-time cross-chat directive detection, and a single audit log so we can SEE whether the rails are actually firing.

units.title: PreToolUse(Edit/Write/MultiEdit) lane gate — block edits in peer-claimed files
exit_conditions: Hook reads chat-bus claim ledger (state/shared/chat-bus/claims/*.json)
Blocks Edit/Write/MultiEdit when target matches an active foreign claim
Allows when target unclaimed OR claimed by own session OR claim expired
Block reason includes peer sessionId + pcName + exact `git worktree add` fork command
Path normalisation: case-insensitive, slash-direction-agnostic
PRISM_CHAT_BUS_CLAIMS_DIR env override for hermetic tests
14-test vitest suite covers all pass-through + block branches
Fail-open on every internal error — never breaks Edit
units.rollback: Remove from settings.json + delete hook file. Existing commit-time rails still apply.

units.title: Auto-fork-executor — actually run `git worktree add` + stash, not just print instructions
exit_conditions: PreToolUse hook on Bash matching `git commit`
Detects when commit would land on wrong tree (cwd is main, no themed worktree exists for scope, scope is parseable)
Auto-creates new worktree at ../prism-<scope>-<idTag> with branch work/<scope>-<idTag>
Stashes work-in-progress (staged + untracked) with key `auto-fork-<scope>-<idTag>-<ts>` so it can be restored in the new tree
Blocks original commit with structured message containing single-line retry: `cd <newPath> && git stash pop && <orig commit>`

Defers silently when (a) [MAIN]/[MAIN-FORCE] override, (b) themed worktree already exists, (c) target branch already exists, (d) all candidate paths collide, (e) git command fails — leaves worktree-commit-route to handle text-only path
PRISM_AUTO_FORK=0 kill switch
13-test vitest suite uses per-test hermetic git repo (mkdtemp + git init + initial commit) to verify worktree actually appears on disk
units.rollback: Remove from settings.json + delete hook. PRISM_AUTO_FORK=0 disables without removal.

units.title: UserPromptSubmit cross-chat directive detector — warn when prompt looks like 'tell other chat to X'
exit_conditions: Hook scans prompts for three pattern shapes: `<claude-XXX> should/needs/must`, `tell|ask|inform <peer-or-broad-target> to`, `(all|every|peer) chats? should/need to`
Strips fenced code blocks + inline backticks + markdown blockquote BEFORE matching to avoid false positives on log-line pastes
Skips self-references — `claude-cba638c3 should X` from cba638c3 is harmless
NEVER blocks — emits additionalContext warning so chat sees it before responding
Echoes targeted entity + sample snippet + `prism_context chat_post` redirect in the warning
PRISM_DIRECTIVE_WARN=0 kill switch
17-test vitest suite covering 8 no-warn paths + 8 warn paths + 1 single-count guarantee
units.rollback: Remove from settings.json + delete hook.

units.title: Arbitration audit log — single source of truth for fork/block/warn events + handoff surface
exit_conditions: Helper at .claude/helpers/arbitration-log.mjs with appendEvent / readEvents / summarizeEvents / renderSummaryLine API + matching CLI
Storage at state/shared/AGENT_CONFLICT_ARBITRATION.json — same file P4-U02 declares as the consensus-gate dissent log (pre-emptively created here)
Concurrency-safe: read-merge-write with .lock dir (mkdir is atomic on Windows + Unix), bounded retry, falls through silently on lock contention
Schema-versioned (1.0.0); bounded to 5000 events; malformed log auto-rebuilt
P5-U01 / P5-U02 / P5-U03 hooks all wire into this log via sync spawnSync of the CLI — never breaks the hook on any error
PRISM_ARBITRATION_LOG env override for hermetic tests
renderSummaryLine produces a one-line handoff string like 'Arbitrations (24h): 3 auto-fork, 1 lane-block — last: auto-fork at <ts>'
14-test vitest suite covers append/read/summary/render-line + schema discipline + in-process API
Combined run of all 4 P5 test files: 56/56 pass (no regression of U01/U02/U03 hooks)
units.rollback: Delete helper + test; remove logArbitration calls from the three hooks. Hooks themselves still function without the log.

compaction_strategy.rationale: Every ≤3 units. Forced compact after P4-U02 because the AGENT_CONFLICT_ARBITRATION substrate fix touches multiple shared files. Tightened from 6 to 8 points after architecture-agent scrutiny flagged two 4-unit windows (P1-U04→P2-U03 and P3-U03→P4-U02) — added P2-U01 and P3-U04 to honor the 3-unit cadence and not strand non-trivial canvas/defuddle work.

variability_axis.inputs: safety tier × edit class × material group (P/M/K/N/S/H) × dialect × machine type × CAM system
variability_axis.states: plan-only · plan→build · build→review · build→consensus · review→fix-loop · consensus-dissent→arbitration
failure_modes: Codex plugin offline / login expired → fall back to Claude-only review with degraded confidence
Ollama provider down → quorum drops below threshold → CONDITIONAL pass with explicit downgrade
All 4 ollama providers AGREE wrongly → mitigated by mandating ≥1 cloud provider in quorum
Codex output too large (>20K tokens) → chunked review per file
Wiki backlink graph cycle → defuddle/canvas chokes → topo-sort detect-and-warn
Canvas regen on 685-node DAG exceeds 5MB → paginate by track
User stages safety-critical edit but plugin not installed → hook degrades to Claude-only with warning
adversarial: Prompt injection in defuddled HTML → sandboxed extractor with whitelist
Path-traversal in [[wikilink]] target → resolver enforces vault-relative
Consensus gate gamed by user re-running until quorum → cache by content hash, refuse re-vote without code change
Hostile patch from compromised Codex plugin → consensus gate catches via Claude+ollama dissent

Random-sample 10 wiki entries open in Obsidian via wikilinks AND render on GitHub
roadmap.canvas opens in Obsidian and shows the full 685-milestone DAG without size errors
P5 multi-chat rails fire on synthetic peer-claim conflict: lane gate blocks Edit, auto-fork creates ../prism-<scope>-<id>, audit log captures both events
exit_gate.scrutiny_floor: average ≥80 on 3-agent scrutiny (this milestone), no agent <60
